sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il sentiment di mercato è risk-off a causa dell'aumento del VIX (+6.26%) e della debolezza dei mercati azionari (S&P 500 +0.77%, ma Nikkei -1.99%, STOXX 600 -1.26%). Il prezzo del petrolio è in aumento (+2.82%) e il DXY è forte (+0.29%), il che contribuisce a un sentiment negativo. Inoltre, la BCE ha mantenuto i tassi invariati, ma il contesto geopolitico, con la guerra tra Israele e Iran, pesa sui mercati.
sentiment.reason_en: Market sentiment is risk-off due to the increase in VIX (+6.26%) and weakness in equity markets (S&P 500 +0.77%, but Nikkei -1.99%, STOXX 600 -1.26%). Rising oil prices (+2.82%) and a strong DXY (+0.29%) contribute to a negative sentiment. Additionally, the geopolitical context, with the war between Israel and Iran, weighs on markets.

market_impact_summary.it: I mercati azionari sono deboli, con S&P 500 +0.77%, Nikkei -1.99% e STOXX 600 -1.26%. Il VIX è aumentato del 6.26%. Il prezzo del petrolio è in aumento (+2.82%), mentre l'oro è in calo (-2.54%). I tassi dei bond sono misti, con il TLT +0.14% e il BTP 10Y stabile. La liquidità globale (M2) è in espansione (+4.6% YoY).
market_impact_summary.en: Equity markets are weak, with S&P 500 +0.77%, Nikkei -1.99%, and STOXX 600 -1.26%. VIX increased by 6.26%. Oil prices are rising (+2.82%), while gold is down (-2.54%). Bond yields are mixed, with TLT +0.14% and BTP 10Y stable. Global liquidity (M2) is expanding (+4.6% YoY).

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.

Il Nikkei ha chiuso in calo dell'1.99%, Shanghai in calo dell'1.02%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura debole per i mercati europei.

L'S&P 500 è salito dello 0.77%, il VIX è in aumento del 6.26%. Il Dollar Index è in rialzo dello 0.29%, mentre l'euro/dollaro è in calo dello 0.68% a 1.16 L'oro è sceso del 2.54% a $4559.3/oz. Il petrolio è in rialzo del 2.82% a $108.7 I rendimenti dei titoli di stato USA a 10 anni sono in calo dello 0.45% al 4.46%.

La Turchia ha abbandonato il suo obiettivo di inflazione a causa delle difficoltà economiche. Le relazioni tra USA e Cina dipendono dalla questione di Taiwan, secondo Xi. Il direttore esecutivo dell'IEA, Dr. Fatih Birol, ha parlato della crisi nello Stretto di Hormuz e della sicurezza energetica globale.

Nessun dato macro rilevante in uscita oggi.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. 
Bitcoin si mantiene sopra gli ottantamila dollari, con una variazione positiva dello 0,89%. 
I flussi degli ETF mostrano un deflusso di 12,2 milioni di dollari. 
Questo movimento potrebbe essere influenzato dalla stabilità del mercato azionario, con l'S&P 500 che ha raggiunto un nuovo massimo storico.

Tra le altcoin, Ethereum scende dello 0,62% a duemilatrecento dollari, mentre Solana guadagna lo 0,07% a novantuno dollari e tredici centesimi. 
BNB invece registra un aumento dell'1,81% a seicentoottantatre dollari e settantanove centesimi.

Il Fear & Greed Index è a 43, in zona Fear, suggerisce cautela sugli investitori.

Sui mercati attendiamo i dati economici in uscita. Per approfondire, trovate gli articoli completi sulla nostra piattaforma. Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en: Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. The Nikkei closed down 1.99%, Shanghai down 1.02%. This suggests a weak opening for European markets. The S&P 500 rose 0.77%, the VIX is up 6.26%. The Dollar Index is up 0.29%, while the euro/dollar is down 0.68% to 1.16 Gold fell 2.54% to $4559.3/oz. Oil is up 2.82% to $108.7 US 10-year government bond yields are down 0.45% to 4.46%. Turkey has abandoned its inflation target due to economic difficulties. US-China relations depend on the Taiwan issue, according to Xi. The IEA's executive director, Dr. Fatih Birol, spoke about the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz and global energy security. No major macroeconomic data out today. Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets... Bitcoin remains above eighty thousand dollars, with a positive variation of 0.89%. ETF flows show an outflow of $12.2 million. This movement could be influenced by the stability of the stock market, with the S&P 500 reaching a new historical high. Among altcoins, Ethereum falls 0.62% to $2300, while Solana gains 0.07% to $91.13 BNB instead records an increase of 1.81% to $683.79 The Fear & Greed Index is at 43, in Fear zone, suggests caution on investors. We are waiting for economic data out on the markets. For more details, find the full articles on our platform. Thanks for your attention and see you tomorrow.

articles.title: The New Era of Air and Missile Defense
articles.snippet: Modern air and missile defense is approaching a structural limit. The model that protected forces over the past two decades remains effective, but only within a narrower envelope than current threats demand. A new approach is required, built on fire-control-level integration, disaggregated survivable architectures, affordable magazine depth, and the integration of offensive action as the central element of defense.I am a retired U.S. Air Force brigadier general and now lead international business development and strategy for Northrop Grumman in Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East. articles.title: How to Win a Trade War: Book launch and discussion with Bown and Keynes
articles.snippet: Soumaya Keynes and Chad P. Bown discuss their new book How to Win a Trade War, available for pre-order. Trade wars are here to stay, and refusing to engage in the fight is no longer an option. President Donald Trump's tariff announcements can crash markets and sour decades-long alliances. China's export restrictions on rare earths could bring the West's car production to a crashing halt. Curbs on trade in cutting-edge chips could determine who wins the artificial intelligence (AI) race. From identifying supply chain vulnerabilities to installing stockpiles, subsidies, and trade restrictions,…

articles.snippet: India’s economic pains are intensifying every day that the Strait of Hormuz remains closed. Two and a half months after the Middle East conflict began, one of the highest-performing emerging markets in recent years and the world’s third-largest crude oil importer is scrambling to contain the oil shock that is spreading to consumer prices, foreign exchange reserves, and economic growth. articles.title: Russia’s Oil Windfall Gets Bigger as Hormuz Stays Shut
articles.snippet: Russia just found itself on the right side of the oil shock. As the Iran war continues to choke flows through the Strait of Hormuz and scramble global crude markets, Moscow’s flagship Urals blend is essentially printing money. For tax purposes, Russia will calculate May oil revenues using an average Urals price of $94.87 per barrel, the highest level since October 2023, according to Bloomberg calculations based on government data. That translates into nearly 7,300 rubles per barrel, up 18% from April. And nearly 60% higher than a year ago.…
